verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's REST API, MCP server, and CSV user import suggest some bulk-capable operations, but there is no explicit documentation of an AI-native bulk operation interface (e.g., batch-triggering/resolving many incidents or bulk-editing many objects in one call) beyond generic API/CRUD references. missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation endpoints or documented batch actions across many items, AI-native bulk-operation examples, independent confirmation of bulk throughput/limits.
